backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, access control, and detailed habit data structures with creation, completion tracking, and volume-tracking logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence list mapping habit-model requirements to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files involved in habit tracking and UI layout.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light and dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up QueryClient, header/footer, auth controls, and rendering BecomingView.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting unauthenticated users to sign in with a LoginButton.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is signed in or not based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with retry handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for loading and mutating habits with actor initialization, optimistic updates, and normalized IC errors.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view orchestrating auth checks, habit loading, error handling, and rendering the habit grid with month selection.
Displays an error message with optional retry button when habit loading fails.
Shows a placeholder skeleton UI for the habit grid while data or auth loads.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit type, and monthly volume with validation and update mutations.
Renders the habit grid with day columns and habit rows or an empty state if no habits exist.
Defines layout constants and helper functions for aligning habit grid columns.
UI for adding new habits, toggling an input row, and submitting habit creation.
Displays a single habit row with info, monthly totals, day completion checkboxes, and popover-driven actions.
Provides a popover for habit row actions, currently supporting editing.
Aggregates reps, time, and numeric volume totals across habits for the selected month.
Renders month selection tabs for navigating between months of 2026.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Defines month metadata for 2026 and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Defines helpers to build and query habit completion maps and compute volume display and monthly totals.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Provides validation, parsing, formatting, and normalization utilities for time strings in M or M:SS formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Creates a backend actor with timeout and error normalization, supporting manual retries and dependency invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, loading and managing user identities and login state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light cyber theme with glass surfaces and touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes errors and detects stopped-canister conditions to produce user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (query or hash), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from storage or the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Defines the Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state and requirements for fixing monthly habit volume calculations, especially correct Plank progression and fixed Squash values.
